extracted.name: Thai Rice Noodle Salad
extracted.description: Rice noodles are tossed with fresh basil, cilantro, green onions, ginger, and a soy sauce-based dressing in this fresh Thai-inspired salad.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil, or to taste
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
1 (1 inch) piece fresh ginger root, minced
instruction_lines: Fill a bowl with boiling water; add rice noodles. Cover bowl and let sit until noodles are softened, about 10 minutes. Drain. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil and toss to coat.
Mix romaine lettuce, red bell pepper, red onion, green onions, cucumber, basil, cilantro, ginger root, jalapeno pepper, and garlic with rice noodles.
Whisk 1/3 cup olive oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, white sugar, lemon juice, lime juice, salt, turmeric, and paprika together in a bowl; pour over rice noodle mixture and toss to coat.
